properties.text: Ukrainian forces advanced in the Oleksandrivka and Hulyaipole directions.

Geolocated footage published on July 6 shows Ukrainian forces striking a Russian position in central Kupyansk after what ISW assesses was a Russian infiltration mission.[46] Russian forces continued offensive operations in the Borova direction on July 5 and 6 but did not advance.[47] Ukrainian forces continued their intermediate-range strike campaign against Russian military assets in occupied Luhansk Oblast.

Russian Subordinate Main Effort #3 – Donetsk Oblast Russian objective: Capture the entirety of Donetsk Oblast, the claimed territory of Russia’s proxies in Donbas, and advance into Dnipropetrovsk Oblast Ukrainian forces continue to hold positions southeast of Lyman.

A Russian milblogger claimed on July 6 that Ukrainian forces seized Piddubne and advanced into central Voskresenka and into Myrne (all east of Oleksandrivka).[64] The presence of Ukrainian forces in Myrne indicates that Russian forces do not control any part of the settlement, as ISW has previously assessed.

[33] A Russian milblogger claimed that Russian forces advanced south of Yampil (northeast of Slovyansk) and in western Zakitne (east of Slovyansk).[34] Ukrainian forces maintain positions southwest of Kostyantynivka as Russian forces continue infiltration missions within the city.

[50] Mashovets stated that Ukrainian forces have cleared Prymorske (west of Orikhiv), seized the road junction between Prymorske and Stepnohirsk (south of Prymorske), and gained a foothold in Plavni (south of Stepnohirsk).[51] Mashovets reported that Russian forces maintain positions on the southern outskirts of Stepnohirsk and conducted infiltration missions north of Stepove (southeast of Stepnohirsk).
Mashovets reported that Russian forces withdrew from areas near Mala Tokmachka, Bilohirya, and Luhivske (all southeast of Orikhiv).

Putin claimed that Russian forces seized 133 settlements and over 3,000 square kilometers since January 1, 2026, and Gerasimov claimed that Russian forces seized 29 settlements and 636 square kilometers in June 2026.

ISW previously assessed that Russian forces reportedly suffered around 1,298 casualties per square kilometer they seized or infiltrated in June 2026 and, at that rate, Russian forces would lose 6,574,590 servicemembers in capturing the remaining 5,065.17 square kilometers of Donetsk Oblast.[6] Putin and other Russian military commanders heavily aggrandized the claimed seizure of Kostyantynivka on July 3 and 4.

[43] A Russian milblogger claimed on July 3 that Russian forces advanced east of Hannivka (east of Dobropillya).[44] Russian forces continued limited offensive operations in the Pokrovsk direction on July 2 and July 3 but did not make confirmed advances.

[50] The Russian Ministry of Defense (MoD) claimed on July 3 that Russian forces seized Oleksandrivka and published footage purportedly showing Russian servicemembers raising flags in Oleksandrivka.[51] ISW is not prepared to assess if the footage was altered with artificial intelligence (AI) at this time.
